title: Tight Bounds for Data-driven Multiple Hyper-parameter Tuning with Structured Loss Function
abstract: arXiv:2608.17343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data-driven algorithm design frames hyperparameter tuning as a statistical learning problem, but establishing generalization guarantees remains challenging due to the implicit, non-smooth dependence of model performance on hyperparameters. Existing multi-dimensional bounds under piecewise-polynomial assumptions remain theoretically loose and lack comprehensive lower bounds. We resolve this by establishing tight pseudo-dimension bounds for multi-dimensional data-driven tuning. First, we refine the learning-theoretic upper bound using real algebraic geometry; by analyzing invariant connected sign cells during block elimination rather than isolated sign vectors, we avoid topological over-counting to derive strictly sharper sample complexities. Second, we present a multi-regime lower-bound framework that disentangles combinatorial and algebraic capacities. By constructing shattered problem instances across distinct regimes, we prove our uppe

translated_title: 数据驱动多超参数调整在结构化损失函数下的紧界
translated_abstract: 数据驱动算法设计将超参数调整视为一个统计学习问题，但由于模型性能对超参数的隐式、非平滑依赖，建立泛化保证仍然具有挑战性。在分段多项式假设下，现有的多维边界在理论上较为松散，且缺乏全面的下界。我们通过建立多维数据驱动调整的紧伪维度边界来解决这一问题。首先，我们使用实代数几何来细化学习理论的上界；通过分析块消除过程中的不变连通符号单元，而非孤立的符号向量，我们避免了拓扑过度计数，从而推导出严格更尖锐的样本复杂度。其次，我们提出了一个多机制下界框架，将组合能力和代数能力分离。通过在不同机制中构造破碎的问题实例，我们证明了我们的上界是紧的。
tldr: 本文通过实代数几何和机制分离的下界框架，首次为多维数据驱动超参数调整建立了严格紧的伪维度边界，显著提升了样本复杂度上界并验证了其紧性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first tight pseudo-dimension bounds for multi-dimensional data-driven hyperparameter tuning via real algebraic geometry and a mechanism-separated lower-bound framework, yielding strictly sharper sample complexity and proving tightness.
